why: The app ships as real files on the customer's PC (electron-builder `asar: false`:
the bundled server chdirs there and spawns ffmpeg/yt-dlp/whisper against those paths).
Nothing stops a person who installs Soundwave from opening
`resources/app/server/dist/**` and reading the agent's instruction, the short-script
shape, the guide and every route as plain source. This file is the shared policy that
makes those files stop reading like source: names, string literals and structure are
rewritten on the way into the installer (`desktop/assemble.mjs` +
`markers` are phrases that MUST exist in the source file they name and MUST NOT exist
anywhere in a shipped tree. The build fails when either side drifts — that is what makes
this check impossible to forget rather than a promise.
It is not, and cannot be, "impossible to steal": anyone with the installer on their own
machine can run the code, dump decoded strings from memory, or reimplement what they see.
This pass removes the cheap wins (a readable copy, source maps, TypeScript types) and
makes copying an expensive project instead of a right-click. docs/PROTECTING_THE_CODE.md.
Option presets below are passed to javascript-obfuscator verbatim — keep them to real
option names only (the engine rejects anything it does not know).

markers.label: the agent's system instruction (PC and phone)
markers.phrase: You are Soundwave, the AI assistant inside the Soundwave AI app on the user's PC.

markers.label: the phone-alone instruction
markers.phrase: Right now the user's PC is off or out of reach, so you are answering from the Soundwave phone app on your own.

markers.label: what the agent knows the app can really do (promo brief)
markers.phrase: Never invent users, testimonials, download numbers, ratings or growth.

markers.label: the short-script shape's own words
markers.phrase: Every line is long. Add two short punch lines (under eight words) to break the rhythm

markers.label: the guide's alarms section
markers.phrase: The agent can set an alarm on your Android phone.

markers.label: the shell's tray wording
markers.phrase: It keeps working in the tray. Right-click the tray icon to quit.
